aboutLong:
I'm a **Game Development student** with a strong interest in **Game Design and Gameplay Programming**. I enjoy understanding how mechanics, levels and systems work together to create clear and engaging player experiences.

Throughout my studies, I have worked on several **team-based prototypes**, contributing ideas, designing gameplay and levels, and implementing mechanics. These projects have taught me how to communicate, organize tasks and adapt my work to the needs of a team.

I like combining **creative thinking with technical problem-solving**, turning ideas into playable features and improving them through testing and iteration. I am motivated to keep learning, take on new challenges and continue growing as a game developer.
